verdict.rationale: Event subscription is a plausible integration question for an authentication product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The only 'notifications' are in-app push approvals mirrored to phones or wearables, which are adjacent and not webhooks. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
